sentences.japanese: 私たちは戦いに勝った。
やった！2回続けて勝っちゃった！
sentences.english: Yes! I won twice in a row!

sentences.japanese: 君は彼女に、勝るとも劣らずかわいい。
sentences.english: You are not less pretty than her.

sentences.japanese: 君のチームには決勝戦で勝つチャンスはないよ。
sentences.english: Your team doesn't have a prayer to win the championship game.

sentences.japanese: 君のチームが試合に勝ってうれしい。
sentences.english: I'm glad that your team won the game.
